title: Compute Relay explicit-attempt log page v1alpha1
description: Read-only bounded output for an original attempt, not verified artifact bytes, execution completion or resource release evidence. Live qualification is provider/account specific.

lines.description: Untrusted diagnostic text. Runtime bounds each line to 16 KiB UTF-8 and the complete page to 256 KiB; schema string lengths count characters.

next_cursor.description: Opaque exact-reference continuation, bounded to 512 UTF-8 bytes by the runtime. Empty means no continuation supplied; a caught-up live page can retain a cursor.

truncated.description: Some output exceeded a retention, event or page bound. Pagination cannot recover discarded bytes.
